_about: Building dimensions for tools/build_factory_shell.mjs. Change a number, run `node tools/build_factory_shell.mjs`, reload /v2. Values come from the site video of 2026-11-09 (docs/SITE_REFERENCE_2026-11-09.md); 'confidence' says how sure each one is. X = length, Y = width, Z = up. Metres.

door._note: the animated sectional gate from the original model (3.8 m wide, 4.2 m high) on the north side wall, in the 5th bay from the far (X = 0) end like the real 12 x 12 ft door

confidence.bayM: high — 354 px between wall columns in a frontal frame, scaled by the 12 ft door, the man door and the 2.4 m wainscot (all three agree): 7.62 m = 25 ft
confidence.eaveM: high — same frame: wall top 5.9 to 6.1 m = 20 ft
confidence.postLinesM: medium — interior post row measured 14.5 to 16.7 m from the door wall in two frames: 15.24 m = 50 ft module
confidence.widthM: medium — end wall visible for about 40 m in the lengthwise frame and the camera stood 28 m from the door wall with building behind it: three 50 ft spans = 150 ft. Could be 100 ft (30.48) if that reading is wrong
confidence.lengthM: medium — 5 bays from the far end to the sectional door column plus the door/roll-up bay plus about 2 more: 8 bays = 200 ft. Could be 7 bays (53.34)
confidence.roofSlope: low — looks like a low-slope 1:12 metal building roof
